title: Pure Legacy of Greed
summary: The Legacy of Greed chain-draw Trap strategy paired with the Lady Labrynth, Arias, and Lord of the Heavenly Prison Trap engine. By chaining differently named zero-condition Normal Draw Traps—Jar of Greed, Legacy of Yata-Garasu, Reckless Greed, and Good Goblin Housekeeping—the deck resolves Accumulated Fortune at Chain Link 4 while Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle Sets fresh Traps from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Arias the Labrynth Butler sends itself from the hand or field to the GY as a Quick Effect on either Main Phase to Set a Normal Draw Trap from your hand and allow it to be activated that same turn.

Absolute King Back Jack rearranges the top three cards of your Deck when sent to the GY, then banishes itself on the opponent's turn to excavate and Set a Normal Trap from the top of your Deck that can be activated immediately.
Trap Trick banishes one Normal Draw Trap from your Deck to Set a second copy directly to your field, live that turn.

Lord of the Heavenly Prison reveals itself in hand to protect all Set cards on the field from effect destruction, and Special Summons itself when a Set Spell/Trap is activated to Set any Normal Spell or Trap from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Lady Labrynth + Three Draw Traps
steps: Set Jar of Greed, Legacy of Yata-Garasu, Reckless Greed, and Accumulated Fortune (or use Arias the Labrynth Butler to fire a Normal Trap on Turn 1 and Special Summon Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle from your hand).

Build a single chain with uniquely named Normal Traps: Chain Link 1 Jar of Greed, Chain Link 2 Legacy of Yata-Garasu, Chain Link 3 Reckless Greed (or Lady Labrynth's Quick Effect), and Chain Link 4 Accumulated Fortune.
Resolve the chain to Set a new Normal Trap from the Deck with Lady Labrynth and draw five or more cards at once.

summary.title: Reckless Greed Stacking & Goblin Housekeeping
summary.text: Reckless Greed draws two cards at the cost of skipping your next two Draw Phases, and because that skip condition does not stack with itself, activating two or three copies of Reckless Greed in the same turn draws four to six cards while still only skipping two Draw Phases total. Good Goblin Housekeeping draws cards equal to the number of Good Goblin Housekeeping copies in your GY plus one before placing a card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck, scaling up as the game goes on.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle (3000 ATK / 2900 DEF) Special Summons itself whenever a Normal Trap or Labrynth effect resolves, cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects while you control a Set card, and Sets a Normal Trap with a different name from the Deck whenever a Normal Trap is activated.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison brings a second 3000 ATK body that shields your Set backrow from board wipes and tutors any Normal Trap from the Deck.
Arias the Labrynth Butler revives itself from the GY whenever the opponent chains to your Normal Trap or Labrynth card.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Accumulated Fortune draws two cards at Chain Link 4 or higher as long as no two cards in the same chain share a name.
Shard of Greed gains a Greed Counter each time you conduct your normal draw and sends itself with two counters to the GY to draw two cards.

main: Jar of Greed
Iconic Normal Trap: draws 1 card with zero cost or conditions, serving as Chain Link 1/2/3 to trigger Lady Labrynth and Accumulated Fortune.
Legacy of Yata-Garasu
Signature Normal Trap: draws 1 card with zero cost or conditions (or 2 cards if your opponent controls a Spirit monster), providing a second chainable 1-for-1 Draw Trap name for Accumulated Fortune.
Reckless Greed

Signature Normal Trap: draws 2 cards and skips your next 2 Draw Phases—and because skipping your next 2 Draw Phases does not stack when you activate multiple copies in the same turn, firing 2 or 3 copies gives you +4 to +6 cards for 1 skipped window!
Accumulated Fortune
Payoff Normal Trap: activates as Chain Link 4 or higher (as long as no two cards in the same Chain share a name) to draw 2 cards!
Good Goblin Housekeeping
Normal Trap: draws cards equal to the number of 'Good Goblin Housekeeping' cards in your GY + 1, then places 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck.
Shard of Greed
Continuous Spell that gains 1 Greed Counter each time you conduct your normal draw and sends itself with 2 counters to the GY to draw 2 cards.
Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle

Core boss: Special Summons itself when you activate Jar of Greed or Reckless Greed, and chains its Quick Effect to any Normal Trap activation to Set a different Normal Draw Trap directly from your Deck!
Arias the Labrynth Butler
Discards itself from hand/field as a Quick Effect to Set a Normal Trap from your hand and let you activate it on Turn 1.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
Reveals itself in hand to protect all your Set Draw Traps from backrow removal, and Special Summons itself when you flip a Set Draw Trap to Set another Trap from your Deck.
Absolute King Back Jack
Rearranges the top 3 cards of your Deck when sent to the GY, and banishes itself to Set the top Normal Trap of your Deck and let it be activated the same turn!
Trap Trick
Banishes 1 Jar of Greed, Legacy of Yata-Garasu, or Reckless Greed from your Deck to Set a second copy that can be activated immediately.
